glosses: assembly, gathering, meeting, sometimes a crowd

examples.text: Dicevano che sarebbe entrata in convento.
examples.en: They said she would enter a convent.

examples.text: Mary ha vissuto in un convento per qualche mese.
examples.en: Mary lived in a convent for a few months.

examples.text: Mary visse in un convento per qualche mese.
examples.en: Mary lived in a convent for a few months.
